# Quanta — Language Core Roadmap

## The Quanta programming language itself.

**Single source of truth for Quanta's own implementation.** All status derived from `docs/status.json` (generated by `test_suites/scripts/verify_status.quanta`, which runs as the `verify-status` gate). Domain capabilities live in `docs/roadmap/domains/*.md`.

> **Currency of this file — audited 2026-10-05.** This roadmap was last
> substantively updated at `0.0.169`; the tree is now `0.0.223`. Its tables
> describe *planned module structure*, and their ✅ marks are claims about the
> existence of those modules, not measured test results. Where this file and a
> measured gate disagree, **the gate wins**.
>
> Known divergences at audit time:
> - The `.qobj` section said G6 cache self-compile was structurally impossible
>   (`G6_SELF_COMPILE_BLOCKED.md`). The `qobj` gate is now GREEN — G6 passes.
> - `docs/status.json` had not been regenerated since 2026-09-08 and referenced
>   the `0.0.020` era of its own version fields.
> - The coverage tables below report `done: 0` for 13 of the 15 domains listed,
>   which is consistent with the 65 ✅ marks being structural claims rather than
>   completed modules. Do not read those two together as "65 modules shipped".
>
> Nothing here has been rewritten to look current. It is marked as-is so the
> staleness is visible instead of implied.

## Self-Improvement Prerequisites (from `status.json`)

Quanta can only self-improve when its core subsystems are in place. These are the **hard prerequisites** before the self-improvement loop (read roadmap → generate code → test → merge) can run:

| SI Component | Prerequisite | Quanta Module | Status (from status.json) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Spec Parser | stdlib I/O + markdown parser | `std/io` + `std/regex` | ✅ verified |
| Spec-to-IR mapper | IR + type system stable | `std/ir` + `std/types` | ✅ verified |
| Code synthesizer | Pattern library + codegen | `std/patterns` + `std/codegen` | ✅ verified |
| Quanta emitter | Compiler + AST + printer | `compiler` + `std/ast` + `std/fmt_ir` | ✅ verified |
| Test generator | Test harness + EXPECTED.tsv | `std/testing` + `test/` | ✅ verified |
| Merge automation | Git integration + CI | `std/git` + `std/ci` | ✅ verified |
| **System integration (blocked)** | Process/thread/futex/pty/stack/raii/mem/clock | `std/process` + `std/thread` + `std/futex` + `std/pty` + `std/stack_trace` + `std/raii` + `std/mem` + `std/clock` | ❌ **MISSING (8 modules)** |

**All 6 core prerequisites ✅ verified** — the 11 stdlib modules exist and are non-trivial. **System integration blocked** — 8 system modules (process/thread/futex/pty/stack/raii/mem/clock) missing; needed for self-hosting SI pipeline.

## 0.0.169: String Parameter Bug Fix ✅ DONE

Fixed critical bug where string literals lost `vreg_is_str` tag when passed as function parameters, blocking Quanta-native SI pipeline.

**Changes:**
- `emitter.quanta`: Added `find_str_source()` helper to follow `IR_MOV` chains to original `IR_STR` source
- `method.quanta`: Call-site string tag recording uses `find_str_source()` to propagate tags through `IR_MOV`
- `entry.quanta`: `IR_PARAM` reads `fn_parstr` to tag param vregs; two-phase compile (parse all → fixup → codegen all)
- `globals.quanta`: Added `fn_parstr` array (200 params × 250000 fns max) for per-param string tags

**Verified:** `file_open(path, 0)` with `path` as function parameter now returns `fd=3` (was `-2`). All 11 gates GREEN. Fixpoint verified.

## .qobj Module System (see `QOBJ_FEATURE_COVERAGE.md` → `status.json`)

**Phase 1 (DONE):** `.qobj` read/write via `qobj.quanta`, `--emit-qobj` flag, `imp_load()` checks `.qobj` first.
**Phase 2 (TODO):** Symbol table separation — track owned vs imported symbols, write only owned to `.qobj`, load only owned on import.
**Phase 3 (TODO):** Separate IR generation per module, emit `.o` with relocations, linker resolves cross-module refs.

## Verification Gate (CI Gate 12)

```
docs/status.json  (regenerated by: bash scripts/regen_status.sh)
      │
      └─ verified by: test_suites/scripts/verify_status.quanta   (gate stage 12)
```

Generation and verification are separate on purpose: the stage only READS
`docs/status.json`, so it can actually detect staleness (a stage that rewrites its
input is green forever).

**Fails if:**
- `docs/status.json` is missing, unreadable, or lacks `generated_at` /
  `si_metrics` / a parseable `generated_at_epoch`
- `docs/status.json` is older than 30 days — the failure message names
  `bash scripts/regen_status.sh`

(A previous revision claimed the gate cross-checked roadmap ✅ marks, compiled
every listed module, and checked Flint/Soup coverage. None of that was ever
implemented — the old stage wrote a hard-coded file and returned 0. Those checks
are a target, not current behaviour.)

Run after all 11 existing gates. Must pass for merge.
